assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 26 November 2022 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
